name: Dulaglutide
description: A weekly GLP-1 receptor agonist formulated as an Fc fusion protein, approved for type 2 diabetes and for cardiovascular risk reduction in that population.

systems.note: GLP-1 receptor agonism on the beta cell.
Hepatobiliary events appear in the class labelling.
Modest weight loss with a lean-mass component.
